{{Quote|This is Sagwa, a very old friend of Chewbacca's. Apparently he was enslaved in a spice mine on Kessel until Chewbacca freed him. While they are not of the same family, they consider each other ''brothers'', and Sagwa feels that he owes Chewbacca a great debt.|C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars 13" />}}
'''Sagwa''' was a [[Wookiee]] [[Gender|male]] who was [[Prison|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines of]] [[Kessel]]. After [[Standard year|years]] of toil, Sagwa was freed by [[Chewbacca]] and participated in a [[Raid on Kessel|break-out]], escaping alongside [[Tak]] and other [[Slavery|slaves]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Stay with me, Sagwa! Keep up!|Tak|<ref name="Solo" />}}
Sagwa was a Wookiee from the inland [[tree]] [[city]] of [[Rwookrrorro]] on the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]. During the [[Imperial Era]] he attempted to defend his fellow Wookiees from Imperial patrols, but was imprisoned and forced to work in the spice mines of Kessel as a slave. He wore an electro-charged [[Shock collar|slaving collar]] and had his shaggy arms bound by heavy shackles. Years of toil took their toll on his body, leaving his [[Color|brown]] fur balding due to illness, though he continued to selflessly spare weaker slaves from the most brutal mining duties.<ref name="Official Guide" />

Sagwa was among the slaves who participated in the [[Raid on Kessel|uprising]] instigated by [[L3-37]], and was freed by Chewbacca after the Wookiee attacked Sagwa's guards. The two Wookiees fought alongside each other, and Sagwa helped Chewbacca and [[Han Solo]] escape the mines with a stash of unrefined [[coaxium]]. Once outside, Sagwa fought off [[Pyke sentinel]]s and helped Chewbacca load the coaxium into smuggling compartments aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. He bid farewell to Chewbacca before following [[Tak]] and other escaped prisoners.<ref name="Solo" /> Following his escape, Sagwa felt that he owed Chewbacca a great debt.<ref name="Star Wars 13" />

At some point after his escape, Sagwa made his way to the [[Smuggler]]'s [[Moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa]] where he worked as a guard at the [[Garkata Fighting Arena]].<ref name="Star Wars 13" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">The events of [[Star Wars (2020) 13|''Star Wars'' (2020) 13]] take place during ''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of to [[3 ABY]].</ref> Sagwa contacted Chewbacca about a sighting of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] on the moon. Feeling indebted to Chewbacca after he freed him from Kessel many years ago, Sagwa helped him, [[Luke Skywalker|Luke]] and [[C-3PO]] escape the [[Unidentified Kanji criminal|goons]] of the [[Kanji Criminal Enterprise|Hutts of Nar Kanji]] by lending cover fire and leading them through a secret passageway. After the skirmish Sagwa, believing it was time to move on from Nar Shaddaa, intended to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Star Wars 13" />

[[Standard decade|Decade]]s later, Sagwa was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Sagwa was a selfless individual, attempting to defend his fellow Wookiees from Imperial patrols on Kashyyyk, and later sparing weaker slaves from brutal toil in the spice mines of Kessel.<ref name="Official Guide" />
